description: Typed source occurrence binding over an existing content-addressed ternary leaf store; no additional root or runtime

identity.occurrence: source_id + revision + rights + scope independent of byte deduplication

ingest.input: explicit allowlisted relative source paths; no recursive implicit private-corpus ingestion
guards: bind read bytes to declared revision and digest
atomic private index and fail-closed writer lock
authenticate caller separately from content hash
check specific occurrence grant before selective hydration
deny revoked or stale occurrence revision
validate hashes at leaf and reconstructed-file boundaries
deny overwrite or transfer of authority from equal bytes
resolve.clarification: This contract does not authenticate an OS caller, sign a DBR, admit a CGX object or grant model execution.

regressions: physical byte dedup without identity merge
disposable test copies, never mutate pinned source

compatibility.distribution: private CGX-AI reference plus separately qualified updates
